- [specs/http-compression/spec.md](/workspace/openspec/changes/make-zstd-support-mandatory/specs/http-compression/spec.md): requirement/scenario contract for always-available zstd decoding, unconditional `Accept-Encoding` advertisement, size limits, truncated streams, and unsupported-encoding reporting.
